assumptions: The caller fills the topic and product summary from the Feature map, the audience from the growth plan and voice notes from the writing style guide.
Fixture pytest covers schema, band, link and escaping validation offline; these cases judge live model quality.
cost_drivers: Two gpt-6-luna calls at most, each with at most 16000 input bytes and small outputs.
effects: Writes reports/SCORE_QUIZ.md in this project. The widget is not deployed anywhere and makes no network calls.

cases.description: A readiness quiz for a developer tool with a real signup link.

inputs.quiz_topic: is your API ready for production traffic
inputs.product_summary: Loopwire shows why each API request was rate limited and lets teams tune limits per client.
inputs.voice_notes: Plain words, short sentences, no exclamation marks.

cases.description: A signup link that could break out of the anchor is rejected before any model call.

inputs.quiz_topic: is your API ready for production traffic

rubric.question: Do the questions and point values actually separate visitors in different situations, with honest verdicts?
Do the CTA and verdicts avoid promising more than the product summary states?
Does the copy follow the voice notes?
